author: Wobybender
body:
Hello Avicus players and staff, tonight, 3/8/15 i got banned by the Moderator _Cyanide, i know what i did, i know that its wrong, and against the rules (combat logging), but, i came here to tell the Staff, as my friends, and 100% honesty, that, my brother (Wobymc) has been fu**ing with me the last month by typing: ¨/leave¨ with a new wireless keyboard that he got from his birthday, that is connected to the computer we use, i have been banned twice now, for my brother typing ¨/leave¨.
he does that every time i get into a killing sprite, or whenever im falling off the void. would you, Avicus Staff, please consider taking the ban away? or at least for less days. Thank you.



Sad face:
(ಥ﹏ಥ)

title: Unfair ban :(

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Whether or not other people are interfering with your computer is irrelevant. You are responsible and in charge of your account, so you must take responsibility for the actions. Considering your infraction history just be glad that this temp-ban isn't any longer. The infraction will expire in 7 days, so in the mean time ensure that your account is secure.

Regards,
Mango_
